definitions: An archway or a structure with a framework covered with climbing plants, used as a shaded walkway or a sitting area.
A garden feature forming a shaded walk or sitting area of pillars or posts that support a series of cross-beams and an open lattice, often upon which woody vines are trained.
examples: The garden featured a beautiful pergola covered in roses.
We enjoyed our afternoon tea under the pergola.
A new pergola was installed to provide more shade.
